entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ProjectReference.ExcludeAssets doesn't work #50170

Closed

  • [Static Web Asssets] Change the Vary header that we add in ApplyCompressionNegotiation to be Accept-Encoding #50150
  • [dotnet test for MTP - Retry] Consider only re-tried test nodes when subtracting failures #48369
    10.0.1xx
  • StaticWebAssetContentTypeMapping cache not being used #49366
  • Incompat with dotnet test settings files and solution usage #10374
    Discussion
  • `dotnet list package --include-transitive` should list *all* packages #50165
  • [Static Web Assets] Respect custom content-type mappings #50152
  • [Static Web Assets] Remove Accept-Ranges header from DefineStaticWebAssetEndpoints #50148
  • error: BLAZOR106 when building on Linux #49038
  • Static Assets are now included when packing a Blazor Web App #49840
  • 'The "UpgradeLegacyStaticWebAssetsToV2" task failed unexpectedly' when building a blazor project #46841
  • dotnet test for MTP: Verify and add test for console app that does "nothing" #49733

Created

  • [wasm] Don't call .NET runtime if browser refresh script for HotReload is missing #50138
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx

  • [Static Web Assets] Fix relative path matching #45039
    untriaged, Area-AspNetCore
  • Allow users to override packaging implementation in generated tool packages #50015
    Area-Tools
  • Add test for MTP test app with empty entry-point that doesn't handshake with dotnet test #50131
  • Implement global --config-file and --diagnostic-output-directory options for dotnet test MTP #50136

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50073
